name: taylorwin
setup: wd = taylorwin(8); w40 = taylorwin(8, 4, -40); w6 = taylorwin(8, 6, -30); w16 = taylorwin(16, 6, -50); w64 = taylorwin(64, 8, -60); w1 = taylorwin(1);
comment: Sig: w = taylorwin(N[, nbar, sll]). Taylor window for radar pulse-compression. Defaults: nbar=4, sll=-30 dB. Bug fix 2026-05-08: previous impl used (-1)^m sign instead of (-1)^(m+1) — inverted output (peak at edges, dip at center). Also incorrectly normalised peak to 1; MATLAB does NOT normalise (peak ≈ 1.52 for default params).
